# KeyPresser product reference

Updated: 2026-11-23

KeyPresser Professional and KeyPresserNext are distinct Windows desktop tools for keyboard and mouse automation. Both are available from the official site.

## KeyPresser Professional

- [English product page](https://keypresser.onepeak.cn/index-en.html) · [中文产品页](https://keypresser.onepeak.cn/)
- Current version shown on the site: 6.5.2. The Windows installer offers English and Simplified Chinese, and includes offline help in both languages.
- The Professional Windows installer lists FinnSoft as publisher. [Official FinnWang-CN/KeyPresser release, installer and SHA-256](https://github.com/FinnWang-CN/KeyPresser/releases/tag/v6.5.2)
- Eight modules: KeyPresser, KeyPresser Image, Mouse Assistant, Mouse Assistant Image, KeyPresser Hardware (Arduino), Window Recorder, KeyMouseGo, and Python Scripting.
- Window Recorder captures keyboard and mouse actions for a selected window. It has a repeat count, playback speed, and pause between rounds. Its default hotkeys are F8 to record, F9 to replay, and F10 to stop.
- The standard KeyPresser module can repeat a key or shortcut at a fixed interval. Independent mode gives enabled rows separate timers. Sequential mode runs enabled rows in order.
- Background input compatibility depends on the target application and the selected input mode. Normal input is intended for foreground use. Test on the target window before running a workflow.
- [English membership pricing](https://keypresser.onepeak.cn/pricing.html): US$49 for one month, US$358 for 12 months, and US$618 for 24 months. Each is a one-time PayPal payment with no automatic renewal.

### Step-by-step Professional tutorials

- [Record and replay Notepad++ tab clicks](https://keypresser.onepeak.cn/notepad-plus-plus-macro-tutorial.html): Record a click on the second tab and then the first, set Repeats to 3, and replay. The tutorial includes an English interface screenshot, default shortcuts, and layout troubleshooting.
- [Repeat a key every second on Windows](https://keypresser.onepeak.cn/repeat-keypresses-windows.html): Use one enabled key row in Independent mode, set both interval values to 1000 ms, and test in a blank Notepad document. The tutorial explains the start/stop hotkey and how to adjust timing.
- [Professional FAQ](https://keypresser.onepeak.cn/index-en.html#faq) · [专业版常见问题](https://keypresser.onepeak.cn/#faq)

## KeyPresserNext

- [English product information](https://keypresser.onepeak.cn/keypresser-next-en.html) · [中文产品页](https://keypresser.onepeak.cn/keypresser-next.html)
- The desktop interface is available in Simplified Chinese. New users can try the app for 15 days without signing up. Continued use requires membership. These terms apply to Next.
- Keyboard, mouse, and image recognition actions share one editable list. Recordings can be edited after capture. The NextCore engine supports sequential and independent execution.
- Default hotkeys: F8 to record and F9 to run or stop. Workflows use a .kpn project and a same-named asset folder when image templates are needed.
- [MCP and DeepSeek Harness setup](https://keypresser.onepeak.cn/keypresser-next-en.html#agent) covers connection setup, target-window binding, action-row editing, and running scripts.
- [KeyPresserNext FAQ](https://keypresser.onepeak.cn/keypresser-next-en.html#faq) · [Next 常见问题](https://keypresser.onepeak.cn/keypresser-next.html#faq)

## Support

If Windows Security or 360 quarantines a KeyPresser file, leave the file quarantined and keep protection enabled. Include the affected file, detection name, and product version when reporting it.

- [KeyPresser issue tracker](https://github.com/FinnWang-CN/KeyPresser/issues)
- [Official English site](https://keypresser.onepeak.cn/index-en.html) · [中文官网](https://keypresser.onepeak.cn/)
